Docs/Quick evaluation

Quick evaluation

Check the environment and adapter loop, then evaluate an actual checkpoint with the registered horizon.

Start with a small wiring run

Research checkout required

The module examples on this page require an asset-complete research checkout, its compatible Python environment, and the relevant simulator or model dependencies. The current public repository ↗ contains a README, license and repository metadata; cloning it does not provide the task modules, robot assets, datasets or checkpoints used below. These examples document the verified research interfaces.

The GR00T evaluation entry point includes a zero-action stub. With its research runtime dependencies installed, use two short episodes to check environment creation, image observations and the rollout adapter. The stub does not load a learned policy.

python -m train.train_groot --evaluate --stub \
  --env-id SharpaAngledClickMouse-v1 \
  --control-mode pd_joint_pos --sim-backend physx_cpu \
  --camera-size 256 --num-eval-envs 1 \
  --num-eval-episodes 2 --num-eval-steps 20 \
  --max-episode-steps 500 --seed 10001 \
  --instruction-sampling canonical
A wiring check has no benchmark interpretation

The short rollout intentionally ends before the task horizon. Its success or failure is not a policy score. The stub still requires the research environment and imports used by the entry point.

Evaluate a learned checkpoint

Replace the example checkpoint path with a compatible, locally available fine-tuned GR00T checkpoint. DexArena checkpoint download URLs have not been published. Keep the adapter and camera contract matched to training.

python -m train.train_groot --evaluate \
  --env-id SharpaAngledClickMouse-v1 \
  --model-path /path/to/checkpoint \
  --control-mode pd_joint_pos --sim-backend physx_cpu \
  --camera-size 256 --num-eval-envs 1 \
  --num-eval-episodes 50 --num-eval-steps 500 \
  --max-episode-steps 500 --seed 10001 \
  --instruction-sampling canonical --capture-video

The 500-step horizon is registered for this mouse task. Query registered_task_settings for another stage. Here --seed 10001 starts the evaluation episode seed range; preserve the explicit seeds in the result manifest. canonical uses the fixed canonical instruction; the entry point also supports registered instruction sampling. Report which rule you used.

Repeat with a frozen policy

Add --scene-background robocasa_l3_s2 and repeat with robocasa_l3_s1 and robocasa_l3_s6. Keep the checkpoint, preprocessing and episode seeds fixed. The native-scene path enforces one CPU environment, the registered horizon and the fixed camera rig.

With video recording enabled, the entry point writes scene_background.json beside the video directory. Save that manifest with the run. A successful run on one stage/background pair is a useful integration check; the complete scene track covers all 30 stages and three backgrounds.

Inspect outcomes before aggregating

Review a rollout video, verify the action dimension and image keys, and confirm that success is read from the environment's task predicate. Record episode success, steps, seed, task ID and any error separately. Failed environment initialization must not silently disappear from the planned evaluation matrix.

Then follow the score protocol and save the reproduction artifacts. For model-specific action conversion, see Policy integration.
